CardPack:cardpack_dragon_assault_auto_sr.description: Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. A rifle with modest rate of fire and capacity that penetrates numerous enemies and sets them on fire. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

CardPack:cardpack_dragon_hammer_sr.description: Hardware: Heavy. A slow-swinging hammer that deals fire damage with powerful knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

CardPack:cardpack_dragon_shotgun_standar.description: Shotgun: Special. Fires a group of firework explosives that deal fire damage. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

CardPack:cardpack_dragon_sniper_scope_sr.description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Powerful and accurate rifle that fires small fireworks that embed in targets and explode shortly after. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

CardPack:cardpack_vindertech_blunt_hamme.description: Hardware: High Tech. A rocket-powered hammer that delivers high knockback at a decent swing rate. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

CardPack:cardpack_vindertech_edged_axe_s.description: Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

CardPack:cardpack_vindertech_edged_axe_v.description: Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

CardPack:cardpack_vindertech_edged_sword.description: Sword: Medium. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with low knockback. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

CardPack:cardpack_vindertech_pistol_auto.description: Pistol: Machine Pistol. Fires at a very high rate, dealing great damage while consuming a lot of ammo. Good for run-and-gun combat, and accurate enough to fight at mid range when fired in short bursts.

CardPack:cardpack_vindertech_pistol_hand.description: Pistol: Semi-Automatic Handcannon. Fires large rounds that deal high damage and knock back targets. Good range, accuracy, rate of fire, and magazine size.

Pistol: Handcannon. Slow-firing revolver that fires powerful rounds that deal heavy damage and knock back targets. Accurate out to mid range.
